Study Title: Erlotinib 100mg or 150mg in Treating EGFR Mutated NSCLC
Brief Summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether 100mg erlotinib had similar effect compared with 150mg erlotinib in NSCLC patients with EGFR mutation in China.
Primary Outcome Measures: Progression free survival, 2 years after the initial dose
Secondary Outcome Measures: The objective response rate, Patients will be followed for an expected average of 6 months
Other Outcome Measures: Overall survival, 3 year after the initial dose|Adverse events, 1 year
Sponsor: The First Affiliated Hospital of Guangzhou Medical University
Study Design: Allocation: RANDOMIZED|Intervention Model: PARALLEL|Masking: NONE|Primary Purpose: TREATMENT
Locations: Guangzhou medical university, Guanzhou, Guangdong, 510120, China
